entries.note: Page opened. Prices accepted for Huon pine craft logs or pieces per cubic metre, undated, raw logs not slabs. Labelled ASKING to keep it out of any maximum; it shows raw timber value only. aud_price is the low end per m3. A slab of about 2 x 0.38 x 0.04 m is roughly 0.03 m3, so raw value is tiny; dealers add milling, drying and margin.

chrome_hint: eBay Australia sold listings: 'huon pine slab' and 'huon pine live edge', Australia only, last 12 months; also Gumtree 'huon pine slab'.
viewing_check: Smell a fresh cut or scraped edge (Huon pine has a strong sweet oil aroma; celery-top and others do not). Photograph the end grain showing very fine, close rings, measure length, width and thickness, and check how far the split runs and whether it goes right through. A thickness under 30 mm limits table use.
